description.value:
You launch a dart of dark void energy that imprints itself on the target, connecting the fates of those marked. Whenever you Cast this Spell and the first time you Sustain this spell on subsequent turns, make a ranged spell attack against the AC of a creature within 60 feet. On a hit, you deal 6d8 void damage (or double damage on a critical hit) and place a mark on their body for the duration of the spell. A marked creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Enfeebled]{Enfeebled 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 1}. When a marked creature is reduced to 0 Hit Points, all other marked creatures become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Off-Guard] and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Clumsy]{Clumsy 1} for 1 round.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.
